title: Alkali-induced catalytic tuning at metal and metal oxide interfaces
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,4164-4182
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01094A, Review Article
Wenjie Liao, An Nguyen, Ping Liu
This review highlights the critical roles that alkali metals play to enable selective bond-tuning in reaction intermediates, thus enhancing catalytic activity and controlling selectivity at alkali–support interfaces.
